notes: Stack Health now watches EVE Corp Finance's daily backup, which had no row at all — it could have stopped for a week without anything noticing. More usefully, the page no longer only tells you things while you're looking at it: when a check goes bad the hub sends you a push, once when it breaks rather than nagging, with a note when it recovers. Several failures at once arrive as one message. The nightly cloud backup is left out on purpose since it already alerts you itself. Unhealthy rows now say how long they've been that way, so you get "failing since 3 days" rather than just failing. And the status dots are shaped as well as coloured — a circle for healthy, a diamond for a warning, a square for a failure — so they can be told apart without relying on colour.
